description: Candidate single-Spark vLLM binding for the exact Poolside Laguna S 2.1 NVFP4 checkpoint 07614121 (71.9 GB, FP8 KV cache scheme, 262,144 positions; the same files the r0b0tlab and Mia singles share). The earlier 826aacdf export (99.7 GB, experts of layers 40-47 in BF16) is not used. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, as in Poolside's model card at 07614121 (README line 185). The steady per-node peak is 0.85 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak. The card's DFlash profile (262,144 context, 32 sequences, a k=15 drafter) is a different recipe shape and is not part of this one.
title: Laguna S 2.1 NVFP4 vLLM single Spark
